senses.gloss: , נִימּ׳ to be softened; to decay; to be sqashed beyond recognition.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 10:4">Nidd. X, 4</cite> <he>עד שיִמּוֹק הבשר</he> until decay has set in.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bikkurim 1:8">Bicc. I, 8</cite> <he>נִמַּקּוּ</he> if the first fruits became decayed. Sifra B’ḥuck., Par. 2, ch. VIII (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 26:39">Lev. XXVI, 39</cite>) <he>אינו אומר יִמַּקּוּ אלא יִמַּסּוּ</he> it does not merely mean ‘they shall decay’ (when a portion remains sound), but ‘they shall dissolve’ (v.

<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 3:4">Nidd. III, 4</cite> <he>נִימּוֹק הולד וכ׳</he> the embryo may have been mashed (mixed up with the blood) before it was passed. Y. ib. III, end, 51ᵃ <he>נִימּוֹקָּה שלייתו וכ׳</he> the placenta was mashed. Bab.

<cite ref="Niddah 27a:39">ib. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>אינו דומה נמוק פעם וכ׳</he> there is no comparison between one presumption that the embryo was mashed and two such suppositions (that the placenta of one embryo and the embryo of another placenta were mashed).

<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 3:8">R. Hash. III, 8</cite> <he>היו נִימּוֹקִּים</he> they decayed (from the serpent’s bites), opp. <he>מתרפאין</he>; a. e.—Tanḥ. Noah 10 <he>נמק יסודו</he>; Yalk. Dan. 1060 <he>נימק סידו</he>, v. infra.

senses.gloss: to squash. Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᶜ bot. שלא תָמֵיק וכ׳ lest she may squash the embryo in her womb.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 7:10">Keth. VII, 10</cite> <he>מְמַקְּתוֹ</he> she (the intercourse with her) will enervate him (the leper).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 92b">Snh. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ סורו</he> (Rashi) his (Nebucadnezzar’s) pride was crumbled (he confessed his wrong), v. <cite ref="M02760"><he>מָרַק</he></cite>; (ed. <he>ה׳ סודו</he> its (the kiln’s) foundation was crumbled (from the heat); [oth. vers. <he>ה׳ סידו</he> the lime in it melted; Tanḥ. Noah 10 <he>נמק יסודו</he>; Yalk. Dan. 1060 <he>נימק סידו</he>].
<cite ref="Taanit 25b:14">Taan. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>עד שיִתְמַקְמֵק ויצטער</he> until he is made submissive (by starvation) and feels pain.
